limits: Container runtime and HTTP resilience use one immutable image; the other stages execute builds from the same frozen software inputs

Facility dispatch and partial arrival are exercised by actual HTTP/SQL race, forgery and rollback tests, a real browser workflow, original cross-warehouse journal recovery and nonempty archive restoration
Sustained actions are bin moves and original-request replays; this does not measure repeated inter-facility dispatch/receiving throughput
Client, two API replicas and PostgreSQL share a development host; no deployed capacity, causal speedup or facility SLO is inferred
All earlier performance windows and dated qualification bundles remain retained

host_observation.limit: One host sample does not identify the cause of latency or establish facility capacity
